description: Use this right after an agent passes check_agent, or whenever the user wants to try an agent. Returns a short Python runner so you can run the agent in this chat with your own Python tool on the user's own data (pasted text, an uploaded spreadsheet, a list). Nothing to install. If Python is unavailable, apply the agent's logic yourself by reading its code. Ask the user for their real data, run the agent, and show the result in plain words.
